paragraphs: Rav Shemayah of Kalnevo. בשס״ח [provisionally: in the new Talmud editions; uncollated], among the variants, another text reads “Shemayah ben Avtalyon in Kalnevo.” He taught: end of Yoma, first chapter, 21a; Zevahim 96a. Rashi explains that Kalnevo is a place named after an idol.
